# Project Overview

- This project is a Team Trivia Challenge prototype.
- Requirements are defined in `specs/PRD.md`.
- Work is tracked in `specs/Tasks.md`.
- The web app is implemented in `app/index.html`.

# How to Make Changes

- Always review `specs/PRD.md` before making changes.
- Always update `specs/Tasks.md` when work is completed.
- Make small changes and complete one task at a time.
- Test changes by opening `app/index.html` in a browser.

# Do NOT Do These Things

- Do not add a backend server or database.
- Do not add login or user accounts.
- Do not add external services or APIs.
- Do not add secret keys or passwords.
- Do not add frameworks such as React or Vue.
- Do not make changes that are not in the requirements.

# When Asked to Add New Features

1. First, ask whether the feature should be added to `specs/PRD.md`.
2. Then create a task in `specs/Tasks.md`.
3. Then implement the feature using the normal project process.
